_about: English text for units whose text global never translated (released after global's end of service, 2024-07-25). Names, titles, leader buff (second title) and skill names come from community translations, matched to global's existing names for returning characters (Beaucy, Feanie, Libram, Rolf, Denah). Skill descriptions are translated from the game's own Japanese text, in global's wording. Used by scripts/gen_translation_mod.cjs; a unit's 'title' is also its first profile title and 'leaderTitle' its second (mana board 2) title.
